units.source_text: 四周气象严肃，使人难于亲近。

en.t: The air all around was solemn and austere, making it hard for anyone to draw near.

units.source_text: 但源氏大将终觉隔帘太不自然，便把上半身探入帘内，将身靠在横木上。

en.t: But Captain Genji finally felt that speaking through the curtain was too unnatural, so he leaned the upper half of his body inside the curtain and rested himself against the crossbar.

units.source_text: 回想从前，随时可以自由相见，六条妃子对源氏的恋慕甚深。

en.t: Thinking back to the past, when they could meet freely at any time, Lady Rokujo's longing for Genji had been very deep.

units.source_text: 在这些岁月中，源氏心情懈怠，并不觉得此人之可爱。

en.t: During those years, Genji's feelings had grown slack, and he had not truly felt how dear she was.

units.source_text: 后来发生了那生魂祟人之事，源氏惊怪此人何以有此缺陷，爱情随即消减，终于如此疏远。

en.t: Later, when the incident occurred in which her living spirit harmed another, Genji was startled and wondered how she could have such a flaw; his love at once diminished, and in the end they became this distant.

units.source_text: 但今日久别重逢，回思往日情怀，便觉心绪缭乱，懊恨无穷。

en.t: Yet today, meeting again after so long apart and recalling the feelings of former days, he found his heart in turmoil and his regret without end.

units.source_text: 源氏大将追忆前尘，思量后事，不禁意气消沉，感慨泣下。

en.t: Captain Genji remembered all that had passed and thought about what was still to come; despite himself his spirits sank, and moved by emotion, he wept.

units.source_text: 六条妃子本来不欲泄露真情，竭力抑制。

en.t: Lady Rokujo had never intended to reveal her true feelings, and she struggled with all her strength to restrain them.

units.source_text: 然而终于忍耐不住，不免泪盈于睫。

en.t: But at last she could endure no more, and tears inevitably filled her eyes.

units.source_text: 源氏大将见此情状，更加伤心，便劝她勿赴伊势。

en.t: Seeing her in this state, Captain Genji was even more heartbroken, and he urged her not to go to Ise.
By then the moon had probably already sunk toward the west.

units.source_text: 源氏大将一面仰望惨淡的天空，一面诉说心中恨事。

en.t: Captain Genji looked up at the bleak sky while pouring out the grievances in his heart.

units.source_text: 六条妃子听了他这温存之言，年来积集在胸中的怨恨也完全消释了。

en.t: When Lady Rokujo heard these tender words from him, the resentment that had gathered in her heart over the years completely melted away.

units.source_text: 她好容易剪断了情丝，今日一会面，又害得她心旌动摇起来，便觉烦恼之极。

en.t: She had finally managed to cut the bonds of feeling, but meeting him again today made her heart waver once more, leaving her in extreme distress.
